modules.title: Introduction to Mkpụrụokwu na Ụda (Sounds and Alphabet)
modules.html:
The Igbo alphabet, vowels, consonants and tones. This section covers introduction to mkpụrụokwu na ụda (sounds and alphabet).

Key points

  • Ahịrịokwu a 'Obi tiri mkpu' nwere ụdị ngwaa (verb) wo — Ngwaa mbufe.
  • Mkpụrụokwu 'Akwụkwọ' nwere sillebu ole — Atọ.
  • Kpọọ aha nkejiasụsụ na-ejikọ mkpụrụokwu abụọ ọnụ. — Njikọ.
  • Mkpụrụokwu 'Mmanwụ' nwere mkpụrụedemede ole — Isii.
  • Gịnị bụ nsonazụ n'ime mkpụrụokwu 'Rie' — e.

Worked examples

Q: Ahịrịokwu a 'Obi tiri mkpu' nwere ụdị ngwaa (verb) wo?
A: Ngwaa mbufe — 'Tiri' functions as a transitive verb (ngwaa mbufe) because the action passes to the object 'mkpu'.

Q: Mkpụrụokwu 'Akwụkwọ' nwere sillebu ole?
A: Atọ — A-kwụ-kwọ has three syllables.

examples.q: Ahịrịokwu a 'Obi tiri mkpu' nwere ụdị ngwaa (verb) wo?

quiz.q: Ahịrịokwu a 'Obi tiri mkpu' nwere ụdị ngwaa (verb) wo?
quiz.solution: 'Tiri' functions as a transitive verb (ngwaa mbufe) because the action passes to the object 'mkpu'.

quiz.q: Mkpụrụokwu 'Akwụkwọ' nwere sillebu ole?
quiz.solution: A-kwụ-kwọ has three syllables.

quiz.q: Kpọọ aha nkejiasụsụ na-ejikọ mkpụrụokwu abụọ ọnụ.
quiz.solution: A conjunction (Njikọ) links words or phrases together.

quiz.q: Mkpụrụokwu 'Mmanwụ' nwere mkpụrụedemede ole?
quiz.solution: M-m-a-n-w-ụ consists of 6 letters in the Igbo alphabet (note: double letters like 'nw' are one letter).

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ nsonazụ n'ime mkpụrụokwu 'Rie'?
quiz.solution: 'e' is the suffix (nsonazụ) added to the root 'ri'.

quiz.q: Mkpụrụokwu ụdaolu:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 8.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ mkpụrụ okwu Igbo maka 'Blood'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Obara.

quiz.q: Kedu mkpụrụ okwu Igbo maka 'Doctor'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Dọkịta.

quiz.q: Mkpụrụ okwu 'ụlọ' nwere mkpi ole?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Abụọ.

quiz.q: Olee mkpụrụasụsụ a kpọrọ 'Uda-anụ' (Voiced Consonants)?
quiz.solution: Voiced consonants like b, d, g cause vibration in the vocal cords when pronounced.

quiz.q: Mkpụrụ ji ole a tọrọ n'ụdọ ka a na-akpọ _____?
quiz.solution: A barn where yams are tied is called 'Oba'.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ andonye (antonym) okwu bụ 'Ogologo'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Mkpụm kpu.

quiz.q: Olee n'ime mkpụrụ edemede a bụ 'Digraph'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: CH.

quiz.q: Mkpụrụ edemede nọ n'ụdaasụsụ Igbo dị ole?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Iri atọ na isii.

quiz.q: Kedu n'ime ndị a bụ mkpụrụ edemede 'ụfere' (fricative)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: s.

quiz.q: Gịnị ka 'Mmanụ e ji eri okwu' pụtara?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ilu.

quiz.q: Kedu isi okwu akwụkwọ 'Ihe Aghasala' (Things Fall Apart)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ọdịda omenala.

quiz.q: Kedu ihe 'Mgbako' (Suffix) na-eme n'okwu?
options: Ọ naghị eme ihe ọ bụla
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ọ na-agbanwe okwu.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Tree'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Osisi.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Ọnụọgụgụ'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Numerals.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Eluigwe'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Sky/Heaven.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Okpu'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Hat/Cap.

quiz.q: Menene ake nufi da 'Kirari'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Praise singing/Epithet.

quiz.q: Me ake nufi da 'Sunauni'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Adverb (Modification of verb).

quiz.q: Menene 'Haruffan Bakar'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Consonants.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Makaranta'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: School.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Orange' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Oroma.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'School' n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ụlọ akwụkwọ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Cat' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Nwamba.

quiz.q: Emume kacha mkpa a na-eme n'oge owuwe ihe ubi bụ...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Iri ji ọhụrụ.

quiz.q: Kedu 'Uda' e ji mara asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Uda olu.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Table'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Tebulu.
